name: ExampleABC - Batch 06 Gmail Reconciliation - SEND DISABLED

parameters.content:
## GMAIL RECONCILIATION / NO SENDING

Reads Prospects, Email Drafts, Contact Exceptions and queries Gmail history. **Explicit approval is OFF in code.** The Gmail Send node is **DEACTIVATED**. This workflow MUST NEVER be used for live sends until thread reconciliation, execution gating, log update and a controlled single-message test are verified.

Gmail OAuth credential must be selected and authorized on the two Gmail nodes. Do not reactivate the send node until approved.
